text: Hi, this is Etienne from Binance Research. Today I want to go through our latest global markets overview for November 2019. Looking at the change in the depth of the bid and the ask quantities for different percentiles, we saw that the ask quantity did increase by roughly 50% from 4,000 to 6,000 BCH. Meanwhile, the buy quantity also increased by nearly plus 33%. What can we think about that? We think that margin trading could potentially lead to greater efficiencies on how resources are allocated within an exchange. Thanks to margin trading, bearish individuals might be able to now construct short positions by borrowing assets from individuals that are long on the asset as they hold the underlying on their portfolios and decided to lock it through offering this for lending purposes.
